payload.rebuttal: argued: The spec's own Out of scope section names this exact limitation: 'The sense of the sentence. The witness pins where the paragraph sits and the four things it names. It cannot tell a paragraph that tells the agent not to run the listed wrong versions from one that tells it to. REVIEW's lenses read that.' The witness was scoped to check placement, outside the injected vocabulary and spec body, and vocabulary, the four named terms, not polarity, by the task I was given. The adequacy lens that raised this finding is the mechanism the spec assigned to catch a reversed paragraph, and it did. The paragraph in implement.md is unchanged from the accepted plan and still tells the implementer not to run the spec's listed wrong versions. Strengthening the witness to parse sentence meaning would go against the scope the task declared, so I made no change.
